subject.title: feat: add codexbar cookie refresh CLI command

question: Should `codexbar cookie refresh --all` be a supported descriptor-wide recovery command for every browser-cookie provider, or should this new CLI surface be restricted to an explicitly maintained provider allowlist?
rationale: The patch and its tests intentionally choose descriptor-driven targets beyond the two providers named in the PR body, while the linked issue is already marked as needing maintainer product review; this supported authentication-recovery scope cannot be resolved mechanically.

options.title: Approve descriptor-wide scope
options.body: Keep the descriptor-driven selection and document that every provider with compatible browser-cookie metadata is an intentional supported target.

options.title: Restrict the initial rollout
options.body: Limit `--all` to an explicit provider list until every descriptor-backed importer has separately proven real-environment behavior.

options.title: Defer the CLI surface
options.body: Keep cache clearing as the existing recovery path and revisit a re-import command after a broader provider-contract decision.

recommendation.title: Approve descriptor-wide scope
recommendation.body: Keep the descriptor-driven selection and document that every provider with compatible browser-cookie metadata is an intentional supported target.

likelyOwner.reason: The available implementation history connects this account to the command and its Keychain-gating follow-up.
